# TENSIX — Sovereign Systems, Agent Protocols & High-Throughput Infrastructure

> TENSIX (https://www.tensix.in/) is an engineering laboratory and systems studio founded and directed by Principal Systems Architect Hemal Shah. It engineers sovereign AI agent protocols (WebMCP, RFC 9421, RFC 9727), high-throughput data extraction engines, enterprise cryptographic email deliverability, and deterministic web architecture for global enterprises, B2B SaaS, and institutions.
